doc: Dash -> ability rows (DashFlow, docs/decisions/0010-dash-ability-flow.md). dash.<ground|air>.<lmb|rmb|e|x|q>: {mode: fire (mid-dash) | buffer (to the dash's end; the default for a missing row) | cancel (ends the dash), carry: dash momentum kept into it, variant: a dash-variant name the kit reads, source: what the source hero does}. into_dash.<slot>: the same for Shift pressed during that ability's wind-up or recovery. kit_owns: the dashes (ground, air) the kit runs in its own state, out of DashFlow's sight until it overrides ArchKit.in_dash(). Dancer: ThiefKit.fires_in_dash reads dash.*.lmb.mode and ThiefKit._empowers reads dash.*.lmb.variant; a move another press starts mid-cartwheel waits out the flip (ThiefKit.play). Combo rows (docs/decisions/0015-combo-flow.md): jump.<slot> (a press mid-jump: fire | buffer to the landing), into_jump.<slot> (a jump in the ability's wind-up or recovery: fire | cancel | buffer | lock; into_dash takes the same modes and an optional air sub-row), hold.<slot>.<ground|air|jump|mantle> (a held slot through that move: keep | cancel). A missing row combines; any other row is an exception and carries a reason and a source.

lmb.source: Data: Quickflip dashes and empowers the next Arcslinger (+214 damage); landing it resets Quickflip. Footage 0193: the Cartwheel and the empowered shot leave on the same frame, so the bolt goes mid-flip.

rmb.source: Data says nothing on casting during Quickflip. Footage never shows Trickshot mid-flip; kept firing: the 0.4s lane starts mid-flip and the throw lands after it.

e.source: Data: Farstep Dagger has no dash rule. Footage never shows it mid-flip. Ours: the throw goes mid-flip; the recast blink ends the cartwheel (she arrives standing).

x.source: Data: Fusillade resets Quickflip; footage (0296-0303): she walks and fires freely through it; nothing shows it locked out by a dash.

q.source: Not in the data or footage (gloves are ours); fires like her other actives.
